newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPAN CITY RESIDENTIAL LAND PRICES STABLE -- AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN CITY RESIDENTIAL LAND PRICES STABLE -- AGENCY.

text.p: Residential land prices in major cities in Japan are almost stable and can be expected to remain flat, a National Land Agency official told reporters on Thursday.
The official also said the pace of decline in commercial land prices in major city areas should continue to slow.
In major city areas, prices of 85 percent of residential land surveyed were flat in the April-June quarter compared with the previous quarter.
In the central Tokyo area housing land prices were flat after showing falls of between one and three percent in the previous quarter, the official said.

Prices of 79 percent of commercial land in large urban areas showed falls of one to three percent, with the number of areas in which prices had fallen by over three percent shrinking from the previous quarter, he added.
But he also said the pace of decline in commercial land prices in some regional cities had increased as new bypass highways made their business centres less attractive.
